claims.hypothesis: Does ambient material entrained into the rotating outflow dissipate its angular momentum
claims.experiment: PV cuts and moment maps of SiO and SiS along outflow edges and axes
claims.result: Rotational velocity decreases with distance from the disk; SiS forms a shell-like layer with complex velocity structure
claims.finding: SiS maps a turbulent boundary layer that may dissipate outflow angular momentum into the surroundings

evidence.quote: This process would dissipate the angular momentum held by the rotating molecular outflow into the surrounding medium.

claims.hypothesis: Do NaCl lines trace accretion shocks on a warped disk
claims.experiment: Compare NaCl v=1 and v=2 maps and a linear-velocity-gradient model
claims.result: Model offsets at disk ends; v=1 and v=2 come from the same regions with the same velocity distribution
claims.finding: Bright NaCl hot spots may be excited by accretion shocks and the disk may be warped

evidence.quote: Bright hot spots in NaCl emission may be excited by accretion shocks from material falling onto the disk.

claims.hypothesis: Does the proper motion of SrcI through the medium shape its environment
claims.experiment: SO maps compared with the expected proper motion and BHL estimates
claims.result: SO shows a steep gradient at the SE end of the disk and a trailing tail to the NW
claims.finding: SO traces a bow shock and trailing plume from SrcI motion through the medium

evidence.quote: These features are created by the movement of SrcI through the medium and Bondi-Hoyle-Lyttleton accretion.

referee_caveats_inferred: Interpretations (entrainment, accretion shocks, warp) are qualitative with no fitted models or uncertainties
Several estimates rest on assumed density, inclination and temperature
Maser contamination of 29SiO peak brightness is only noted, not corrected

missing_for_reproduction: Calibration and imaging recipe (deferred to Ginsburg2018)
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Large: three long-baseline ALMA execution blocks (Band 6, Band 7 and Band 3) across two projects, likely tens to hundreds of GB raw
reproducibility.score_reason: Project codes and observing dates are given, but calibration, imaging parameters and analysis details are not, and results are mostly qualitative or images
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Recipe incomplete and main results are mostly qualitative maps rather than numeric answers
